purpose: Keep GitHub-hosted SEIS improvement work modular, humane, observable, and rollback-safe while the ecosystem grows across design, code, content, plugins, and deployment surfaces.
operatingPrinciples: start from the smallest reversible slice
preserve accessibility and reduced-motion support before adding spectacle
make every broad operating rule traceable as documentation or a machine-readable record
prefer source clarity and governance over builder convenience
validate with the lightest check that proves the change

maturityLevels.name: Foundation Integrity
maturityLevels.intent: Confirm the repository has a stable operating spine before expansion.
entrySignals: clean working tree before new work
target files and rollback path identified
exitSignals: focused checks pass without dependency expansion

maturityLevels.name: Calm Experience System
maturityLevels.intent: Improve user-facing interfaces with restrained cinematic hierarchy and low cognitive load.
entrySignals: accessibility and motion constraints are named
visual changes are scoped to one surface
exitSignals: mobile and performance budgets are respected

maturityLevels.name: Governed Automation
maturityLevels.intent: Add AI-native and script-driven acceleration only when it remains auditable and reversible.
entrySignals: automation purpose is mapped to a repository record
publish claims are blocked until branch and auth state are explicit
exitSignals: automation has a focused check command
outputs are committed as traceable artifacts when needed
no forced push, deploy, or destructive cleanup is introduced

maturityLevels.name: Platform Readiness
maturityLevels.intent: Prepare SEIS for deployment, plugin routing, and cross-surface growth without losing source clarity.
entrySignals: hosting or builder target is explicit
integration source is trusted or isolated
server/upload target remains gated until confirmed
exitSignals: plugin and connector use stays family-routed
release readiness is proven before shipment

developmentLoop.question: What is the smallest GitHub-visible SEIS improvement that matters now?
developmentLoop.proof: One target surface, one outcome, and one rollback path are named.

developmentLoop.question: Which model layer should change: experience, governance, automation, content, or deployment?
developmentLoop.proof: The changed layer has a human-readable doc or machine-readable record.

developmentLoop.question: Can the change be validated locally without broad dependency or build pressure?
developmentLoop.proof: Focused npm/script checks pass and the worktree is ready for commit.

developmentLoop.question: Are branch, remote, authentication, and deployment claims explicit?
developmentLoop.proof: Publication is claimed only after the UIXAppTTR branch contract and GitHub readiness are known.

qualityGates.scope: Validate this SEIS evolution model and its paired strategy document.
Confirm the working tree remains in the expected SEIS/UIXAppTTR routing shape.
Confirm the development cadence and remote-claim safeguards remain aligned.

rollbackPolicy.default: Revert the smallest commit or restore the previous JSON/doc pair.
blocks: remote branch deletion without explicit authentication and branch review

currentFocus.intent: Turn the evolution model from a descriptive artifact into an actionable operating layer for the next SEIS increments.
currentFocus.decisionBias: Improve the static, accessible, rollback-safe foundation before adding frameworks, deploy automation, or heavier visual systems.

activationQueue.title: Refine the development cockpit hierarchy
activationQueue.nextAction: Audit the current cockpit sections and improve one visible hierarchy issue without changing the dependency stack.
acceptanceCriteria: one public interface section has clearer editorial hierarchy
keyboard and semantic structure remain intact
activationQueue.rollback: Restore the previous static markup and style block for the touched section.

activationQueue.title: Tune mobile motion timing
activationQueue.nextAction: Reduce any mobile reveal or transition pressure only after checking the current motion policy.
acceptanceCriteria: mobile animation remains subtle and non-blocking
activationQueue.rollback: Restore the prior motion constants or CSS transition values.

activationQueue.title: Confirm production server target
activationQueue.nextAction: Collect domain, host, document root, upload method, and rollback path before any upload claim.
acceptanceCriteria: automatic deploy remains blocked until confirmation
activationQueue.rollback: Revert target records and keep the local release package unchanged.

activationQueue.title: Choose the mobile starting path
activationQueue.nextAction: Compare PWA-first, Expo, and native paths against accessibility, motion, cost, and rollback constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: mobile path decision has a documented rationale
installability and touch ergonomics are considered
native expansion is not started before the path decision
activationQueue.rollback: Reopen the decision record and return to PWA-first static operation.

activationQueue.title: Keep agent workstreams inside UIXAppTTR
activationQueue.nextAction: Record agent-driven changes as small UIXAppTTR commits with focused validators and no long-lived branch sprawl.
acceptanceCriteria: agent output is traceable to repository records
no forced push or remote branch deletion is introduced
work is committed only after focused checks pass
activationQueue.rollback: Revert the smallest agent commit and preserve branch history.

decisionMatrix.when: A request is broad or strategic
decisionMatrix.route: Create or update a governance or strategy record before editing runtime surfaces.
decisionMatrix.avoid: Untraceable broad rewrites or builder-only changes.

decisionMatrix.route: Make one calm, accessible, reduced-motion-aware interface slice.
decisionMatrix.avoid: Dense animation, visual chaos, or dependency-heavy framework migration.

decisionMatrix.when: A request asks for deployment or publishing
decisionMatrix.route: Check branch, remote, auth, target, artifact, and rollback readiness first.
decisionMatrix.avoid: Automatic upload or remote shipment claims before explicit target confirmation.

decisionMatrix.when: A request asks for automation or AI-agent acceleration
decisionMatrix.route: Keep outputs auditable through records, focused validators, and small commits.
decisionMatrix.avoid: Hidden state, unbounded tool use, or destructive cleanup.

preferredSignals: branch and publish claims explicitly gated
antiSignals: branch sprawl or unreviewed remote cleanup
